# Skill

Validate Framework

## Purpose

Check that the Robot project is ready to run.

## Inspect

- Project folders
- Resource paths
- Library imports
- Variables and workbook data

## Check

- Required folders
- Valid resource paths
- Installed libraries
- Clear keyword names
- Reusable cleanup
- Selectors in locator files

## Process

1. Check the project structure.
2. Run a dry run.
3. Run one focused test.
4. Run the selected suite.
5. Record failures and limits.

## Output

- Checks completed
- Checks skipped
- First failure
- Owning file
- Final readiness status
